reduced_model_lock.title: A continuum-based model for a layer jamming beam
reduced_model_lock.selected_formulation: Published continuum-based layer-jamming beam model (CLJM): piecewise full-jamming, half-slipping and full-slipping section laws; continuous slip boundary y_s(s); N-Q-M beam equilibrium; jammed-section bending inertia I_J(y_s); incremental geometrically updated deformation algorithm; no modified or fitted variant
reduced_model_lock.modeling_level: structural continuum beam, not RVE constitutive model
reduced_model_lock.local_section_first_yield_relation: Q_slip_section=(2/3)*mu*p*b*h; valid under the source's fully jammed parabolic shear idealization; it is not directly external P_onset
main_assumptions: nominal pressure sets friction limit mu*p
radius of curvature much larger than h for straight-beam shear approximation
documented_limitations: slip zone wider than source FEA
stress discrepancy in full slipping/curved regions
published n approximately 10 statement does not define a project error tolerance
reduced_model_lock.source: data/papers/verification/D1-V002/2025-A continuum-based model for a layer jamming beam.pdf; PDF pp. 1-9, especially Eqs. (1)-(20); paper_id=95646b2cfc

reference_model_lock.role: higher-fidelity finite-layer interface-resolving numerical comparator, not physical ground truth
reference_model_lock.proposed_architecture: same planar beam test family as M; every finite physical layer and interface explicit; unilateral normal contact; Coulomb tangential friction; local pressure redistribution and stick/slip evolution; finite-rotation capability for intended bending-severity domain

feature_classification.reason: n is a proposed breakdown axis
minimum shared law with M; regularization must be disclosed
must emerge from contact equilibrium to test M omission
permit if physical envelope and loading allow; otherwise justify exclusion
required for intended finite-rotation bending domain; restricted small-rotation study must be separately declared
support compliance alters w and slip
separate parameter discrepancy from model discrepancy
nominal applied vacuum input must match; local R traction is solved output
required if edge/membrane/widthwise effects influence outputs
add when pilot/specimen evidence indicates a confound

feature_classification.feature: paper Abaqus settings as final R
feature_classification.reason: published examples do not fix project solver or verification

comparability_contract.rule: all applicable checks must pass for a paired M-R state; failed rows are NOT_COMPARABLE rather than model-form errors
checklist: same independently calibrated material and friction parameters
same nominal pressure sign/gauge/spatial/time definition and evacuation sequence
same external force vector, location, control and ramp
same material station and local/global axis/sign
same w(P) extraction and P grid
comparability_contract.calibration_rule: do not fit M parameters to final R/E validation responses
comparability_contract.model_discrepancy_caveat: M-R combines finite-layer and other omitted physics unless matched-physics ablations distinguish them

w.physical_definition: transverse free-end initial-material-section centerline displacement relative to equilibrated vacuum-only state, along fixed laboratory load axis, on first monotonic loading branch; response function w(P;p,n)
w.evaluation_location: initial cantilever free-end material section s=L
w.loading_state: predeclared external force P after pressure equilibrium on first monotonic branch
w.M_extraction: incremental CLJM centerline tip position minus vacuum-only baseline
w.R_extraction: predeclared thickness-weighted mean of corresponding layer-end material-point transverse displacements minus baseline; validate experimental mapping
w.future_E_extraction: calibrated tip marker/optical centroid in same axis, pressure-only baseline and fixture motion removed
w.normalization_rule: absolute difference in m for gate, or divide by positive predeclared engineering deflection scale W_use; historical relative ratio only if denominator resolved
w.near_zero_rule: no division by w_R near zero; use absolute/fixed-scale metric

K.physical_definition: structural chord stiffness K=(P_b-P_a)/(w(P_b)-w(P_a)) on a predeclared first-loading interval; not tangent stiffness or effective EI
K.evaluation_location: same free-end w signal at two specified external loads
K.loading_state: P_a<P_b, pressure and branch fixed; interval/regime not yet selected
K.M_extraction: evaluate M w at fixed endpoints then chord
K.R_extraction: evaluate R w at same endpoints with frozen interpolation then chord
K.future_E_extraction: replicate mean deflections at same force targets, correct fixture compliance, propagate endpoint covariance
K.normalization_rule: absolute difference in N/m or positive predeclared K_use; relative ratio only if K_R resolved
K.near_zero_rule: if delta_w is below its uncertainty, mark K NOT_ESTIMABLE

Q_slip.physical_definition: candidate physical first sustained relative tangential motion of adjacent layers in a predeclared observation domain; common external event load P_onset preferred; source Q_slip is local analytical section yield capacity
Q_slip.units: N for internal Q or external P; they are distinct quantities
Q_slip.evaluation_location: first eligible interface/station in frozen observation domain
Q_slip.loading_state: first monotonic transverse loading after fixed pressure/preconditioning
Q_slip.M_extraction: earliest eligible M section reaching abs(Q(s)) >= (2/3)*mu*p*b*h, then record internal Q and corresponding external P
Q_slip.R_extraction: bracket first sustained local relative motion/contact slip between last no-slip and first-slip steps, with spatial/contact convergence
Q_slip.future_E_extraction: direct interface markers or DIC plus synchronized load; global force-deflection kink named P_apparent, not silently equated to first slip
Q_slip.normalization_rule: absolute event-load difference in N or fixed positive P_use; internal-Q metric only with locked equilibrium mapping
Q_slip.near_zero_rule: near p=0 use absolute/event-interval comparison; left-censor undetectable onset
ambiguity_risks: analytical yield differs from contact motion
local event differs from global kink

uncertainty_budget.shared_rule: for D_Y=Y_M-Y_R, u^2(D_Y)=u^2(Y_M)+u^2(Y_R)-2cov(Y_M,Y_R); shared physical inputs need correlated propagation and independent parameter calibration

K.derived_output: for K=delta_P/delta_w, u_K^2≈u_delta_P^2/delta_w^2+delta_P^2*u_delta_w^2/delta_w^4-2*delta_P*cov(delta_P,delta_w)/delta_w^3; small delta_w amplifies noise

Q_slip.event_detection_separate: false-event rate, first-detectable displacement, and interval censoring must be characterized separately from ordinary load measurement uncertainty

missing_studies: direct onset detector resolution and false-event study

engineering_relevance.w: need service load, allowable deflection/positioning or clearance decision and margin
engineering_relevance.K: need pressure-selection or jammed/slipping stiffness requirement at specified load interval and decision margin
engineering_relevance.Q_slip: need operating-load/safety or trigger margin relative to first slip and required detection resolution
engineering_relevance.derivation_architecture: derive an output-specific engineering allowance and independent uncertainty floor under a predeclared coverage convention; if uncertainty is comparable to/exceeds decision margin, classification is unresolved; no number is inferred here
